in_marathi.name: Dhenu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhenu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhenu is the name of the divine cow that is the source of all life-giving milk. She is often depicted with the moon on her horns and represents nourishment, abundance, and prosperity.
